rationale: A is more robust because it expands all words at definition time, preserving the meaning of built-ins and user-defined words even after later redefinitions. It also implements integer division truncated toward zero, whereas B uses Python floor division and therefore gives incorrect Forth-style results for negative operands. B's top-level helpers and OVER implementation are somewhat clearer, but its token-list rewriting is less direct and can behave poorly with recursive definitions; A's unified action representation is the stronger overall design.
